sources.title: Reachy Mini — Free STLs, Code & BOM
sources.snippet: Reachy Mini — Open-Source Expressive Desktop Robot An open-source desktop robot designed for hackers and AI builders who want a tangible platform for multimodal interaction experiments. Ships as a flat-pack 3D-printed kit that assembles in roughly 2-3 hours: 6-DOF Stewart-platform head, two antennas, and a rotating base packed with sensors.
